widget.name: Ax New Custom Table
widget.description: Data table built on antd Table. Dynamic mode renders from JSON with client-side paging, sorting and search; Datasource mode renders from Mendix datasources with server-side paging and search.

property.caption: Data Mode
property.description: Dynamic: rows come from Header/Data JSON. Datasource: rows come from Columns/Data Items with server-side paging.

property.caption: Scroll Mode (Dynamic)
property.description: Dynamic only. Pages: paged table. Virtual scroll: one scrolling window for very large data (Pagination is ignored).

property.caption: Is Loading
property.description: Shows the loading state while true.

property.caption: Show Search Box
property.description: Shows the search box.

property.caption: Search Placeholder
property.description: Placeholder of the search box.

property.caption: Search Debounce (ms)
property.description: Delay after typing before searching, in milliseconds.

property.caption: Header JSON
property.description: Column definitions, e.g. [{"header":"Name","label":"Name","width":120}]. Options: label, width, minWidth, grow, sortable, align, wrap, hidden, formatType, formatPattern, badgeColors, treeColumn.

property.caption: Data JSON
property.description: Rows, e.g. [{"RowKey":"1","Name":"A"}]. Optional: ParentRowKey (parent row, for child rows), HasInvalid (true disables the row).

property.caption: Columns
property.description: Datasource of the table columns.

property.caption: Column Key
property.description: Key of the value in each row's Row Values JSON.

property.caption: Column Label
property.description: Header text.

property.caption: Column Width
property.description: CSS width, e.g. "120px". Empty = automatic.

property.caption: Column Sortable
property.description: Whether the column can be sorted. Default: false.

property.caption: Column Visible
property.description: Whether the column is shown. Default: true.

property.caption: Data Items
property.description: Datasource of the rows on the current page.

property.caption: Row Key
property.description: Unique identifier of the row.

property.caption: Row Values (JSON)
property.description: JSON object of column key to value, e.g. {"name":"Acme"}. Optional "ParentRowKey" links a row to its parent.

property.caption: On Fetch Data
property.description: Runs when the page, page size or search text changes, after the attributes below are written. Refresh Data Items here.

property.caption: Offset Attribute
property.description: Written with (page - 1) * page size before On Fetch Data runs.

property.caption: Limit Attribute
property.description: Written with the page size before On Fetch Data runs.

property.caption: Total Count Attribute
property.description: Total number of rows, read after On Fetch Data. If empty, the next page is assumed when a full page is returned.

property.caption: Filter Text Attribute
property.description: Written with the search text before On Fetch Data runs.

property.caption: Enable Pagination
property.description: Shows the page footer.

property.caption: Pagination Mode
property.description: Datasource only. Pages: page footer. Load more: appends rows with a button.

property.caption: Default Page Size
property.description: Initial number of rows per page.

property.caption: Page Size Options
property.description: Comma-separated page sizes to choose from.

property.caption: Enable Row Selection
property.description: Shows checkboxes to select rows.

property.caption: Single Row Selection
property.description: Allows only one selected row (radio buttons).

property.caption: Highlight Selected Rows
property.description: Highlights selected rows.

property.caption: On Selection Change
property.description: Runs when the selection changes.

property.caption: Enable Expandable Rows
property.description: Rows with child rows (ParentRowKey) can be expanded.

property.caption: Expand On Row Click
property.description: Clicking a row expands or collapses it.

property.caption: Pointer Cursor On Hover
property.description: Pointer cursor over rows.

property.caption: On Row Click
property.description: Runs when a row is clicked.

property.caption: On Row Double Click
property.description: Runs when a row is double-clicked.

property.caption: Striped Rows
property.description: Alternating row background.

property.caption: Highlight On Hover
property.description: Highlights the row under the cursor.

property.caption: Dense
property.description: Compact row height.

property.caption: Responsive
property.description: Scrolls horizontally when the table is wider than its container.

property.caption: Fixed Header
property.description: Keeps the header visible while scrolling.

property.caption: Fixed Header Scroll Height
property.description: Table height before it scrolls, e.g. "400px". Virtual scroll needs a px value.

property.caption: Persist Table Head
property.description: Keeps the header visible while loading or when there are no rows.

property.defaultValue: There are no records to display
property.caption: No Data Text
property.description: Shown when there are no rows.

property.caption: Loading Text
property.description: Shown while loading.

property.caption: Total Text
property.description: Row count text; {count} is the number of rows. Empty = hidden.

property.caption: Load More Text
property.description: Label of the Load more button.
